author: Splades
body:
Hello, Splade here I have been looking for a clan to join since many of my in-game friends have a clan. My best skill in Nebula is rushing. Clans look like fun and I would really like to join one just because xD So anyways my best skill is rushing and I will usually destroy a monument every game unless there's like 5+ defenders guarding one xD. So yeah I'm just looking for one to join:P

Thanks for reading! ~Splade
